messages.subject: gvisMap Not Rendering Correctly
parts:
I am working with a ShinyApp that uses googleVis and renderGvis to create a google map with geo-coded addresses.  Several issues I am having is the info window for a marker gets cut off or has scroll bars, which is not user friendly.  Also, the zoom bar on the left side does not show fully.  The link to my app is as follows: https://psuddar.shinyapps.io/PennsylvaniaGuides/

 Any solutions?  My partial code is below:

#ui.R

library(shiny)
library(googleVis)

datatbl<-read.table("Data/PAGuides.csv",sep=",",header=TRUE)

shinyUI(fluidPage( 
  
  div(class="outer",
      
    tags$head(
      # Include our custom CSS
      includeCSS("style.css")
    ),
    
    htmlOutput("guidemap"),
  
    absolutePanel(id="controls", top = 60, left = "auto", right = 20, bottom = "auto",
                  width = 330, height = "auto", draggable=TRUE,               
        h2("Guide Filter"),
        selectInput('sppselect', 'Species', c("All",as.character(sort(unique(datatbl$Species)))),'All')
    )
  )
))

#server.R

library(shiny)
library(googleVis)

#Additional code for reactive drop down, dataSelect, etc.
   
  #Render Gvis Map
  output$guidemap<-renderGvis({
    tbl<-dataSelect()
    gvisMap(tbl, "Location" , "Tip", options=list(showTip=TRUE, showLine=TRUE, enableScrollWheel=TRUE,
                                                  mapType='hybrid', useMapTypeControl=TRUE))
  })  
})
  

Thanks in advance.
